get.summary: Nearest past cases by narrative embedding
get.description:
Nearest case narratives by cosine similarity over the HNSW index.

Similarity answers "does this look like something I have seen before"; the entity graph
answers "is this connected to something I have seen before". They are different questions and
the console shows both.

post.summary: Ask the read-only analyst copilot about a decision
post.description:
Explain a decision that has already been made.

Read-only by construction: the copilot reaches the database only through the tool registry in
app/llm/tools.py, whose sessions run in a Postgres READ ONLY transaction that is always rolled
back. There is no code path from here to a score or a decision (CLAUDE.md invariant 1).

AdverseActionNotice.title: AdverseActionNotice
AdverseActionNotice.description: Reg B (12 CFR 1002.9)-shaped notice. Applicant-facing: plain-language reasons only, no raw features/scores.

ApplicationEvent.title: ApplicationEvent
ApplicationEvent.description:
A raw credit application: every BAF column plus synthetic identifiers used for the entity graph.

Protected attributes (customer_age, employment_status, income) are accepted for fairness evaluation
but are never model features (enforced in ml/featurize.py).

cited_reasons.title: Cited Reasons
cited_reasons.description: Feature keys of reason codes on this decision cited in the answer

blocked.title: Blocked
blocked.description: True if guardrails refused the question

fallback_used.title: Fallback Used
fallback_used.description: True if the LLM failed and a templated answer was returned

DecisionOutcome.title: DecisionOutcome
DecisionOutcome.description: What happens to the application. Band = risk tier; decision = resulting application status.

EntityGraphResponse.title: EntityGraphResponse
EntityGraphResponse.description: Bipartite application<->entity neighbourhood (2 hops, capped at GRAPH_MAX_NODES).

band_mix.title: Band Mix
